en-US.author: Yicheng Wang
en-US.description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.
en-US.longDescription: Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
en-US.name: Runner
en-US.releaseNotes:
Runner 0.19.8 is a feature release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.7, with agent version checks and background updates, new Usage settings and more reliable remote connections.
New
- Agent updates without blocking the window. Runner now refuses to start an agent version it knows is incompatible, starting with Codex below 0.149.0, instead of failing with confusing launch errors. Starting a chat, role or mission slot on an outdated agent updates it in the background: that pane waits until the update finishes while the rest of the window stays usable. Settings → Agents shows required and optional updates on each agent, a dot on the sidebar's Settings button points to them, and you can open the update's terminal if it asks for input. (#1165)
- Usage settings. Settings → Usage controls the sidebar usage badges, how often usage is checked, the five-hour limit window and near-limit notifications, with a compact preview of the sidebar footer. Checks stop when badges and alerts are both off. (#1249, #1271)
- Skills and MCP tabs for each agent. Each agent's Skills and MCP catalogs now live on that agent's own Settings page, next to a General tab. For Claude Code, they follow the selected account. (#1249)
- Launch options with a command preview. Settings → Agents adds a Launch card for each agent: Bypass for Codex and Claude Code chats (off by default), turning off Codex's remote plugin catalog, and turning off status hooks for chats. A copyable preview shows the exact chat and mission command Runner will run. (#1246)
- Switch sidebar views from the keyboard. ⌘. on macOS or Ctrl+. on Windows and Linux switches between the Projects and Active views and expands a collapsed sidebar. The shortcut can be rebound or removed in Settings and is in the command palette. On Windows and Linux, a terminal program that claims Ctrl+. still receives it first. (#1266)
Bug fixes
- More reliable remote connections. A remote window now notices a silently dropped network within about 15 seconds and reconnects, a single slow request no longer drops the whole connection, and typing survives short write stalls. On the host, one slow channel no longer holds up the others, and busy terminals no longer flood the relay. Reconnecting now shows as a centred pill over the terminal instead of a bar across it. (#1263)
- Restored Codex chats keep their colours. Restoring an archived Codex chat no longer paints the composer and your prompts in fallback colours. The chat restarts with a fresh terminal and keeps its conversation and launch settings. (#1257)
- Remote sidebars remember their view. A window connected to another computer remembers that host's sidebar filters and which projects and groups are collapsed. The first time you connect to a host, only projects with nothing open start collapsed. (#1272)
- Readable remote folder menu. The folder menu behind Change in a remote window's launcher is no longer squeezed to the width of the link. (#1238)

zh-CN.description: 让 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI 等终端编码智能体在同一个 mission 上协同工作。
zh-CN.longDescription: Runner 是一款原生桌面应用，让终端智能体协同工作。Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor CLI、Grok Build、Antigravity CLI、Copilot CLI 与 pi 可以在同一个任务、同一个 mission 中配合，每个智能体都保留自己真实终端里的 TUI，由 lead 把决策带回给你。Runner 的一切能力都对应一个 `runner` 命令：mission、crew、role、project、chat、session 与 msg 都能在命令行操作，后台服务是 `runnerd`。智能体在 Windows 上原生运行，不需要 WSL，PowerShell 7 为可选。当前状态：alpha，持续发布。原生支持 macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows（x64，Windows 10 1809 或更高版本）；不支持 Intel Mac、Windows ARM64 与 Linux。安装程序、应用与 CLI 辅助程序均使用签发给 Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang 的 Certum 开源代码签名证书签名。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Runner 0.19.8 是 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上基于 0.19.7 的功能版本，新增 agent 版本检查与后台更新、Usage 设置，并提升了远程连接的稳定性。
新功能
- 后台更新 agent，不阻塞窗口。 遇到已知不兼容的 agent 版本（目前为低于 0.149.0 的 Codex），Runner 会直接拒绝启动并说明原因，不再出现难以理解的启动错误。用过旧的 agent 启动聊天、角色或 mission 位置时，Runner 会在后台更新它：该窗格等待更新完成，窗口其余部分照常可用。Settings → Agents 在每个 agent 上标出必需和可选更新，侧边栏 Settings 按钮上的圆点会提示有可用更新；更新需要输入时，可以打开它的终端。 (#1165)
- Usage 设置。 Settings → Usage 可以设置侧边栏用量徽标、用量检查频率、五小时限额窗口和接近限额通知，并附带侧边栏底部的紧凑预览。徽标和提醒都关闭时，停止检查用量。 (#1249, #1271)
- 每个 agent 独立的 Skills 和 MCP 标签页。 每个 agent 的 Skills 和 MCP 列表移到该 agent 自己的设置页，与 General 标签页并列；Claude Code 的列表跟随当前选中的账号。 (#1249)
- 启动选项与命令预览。 Settings → Agents 为每个 agent 新增 Launch 卡片：Codex 和 Claude Code 聊天的 Bypass（默认关闭）、关闭 Codex 的远程插件目录、为聊天关闭状态 hook。可复制的预览会显示 Runner 实际执行的聊天与 mission 命令。 (#1246)
- 用快捷键切换侧边栏视图。 macOS 上按 ⌘.，Windows 和 Linux 上按 Ctrl+.，即可在 Projects 和 Active 视图间切换，并展开已折叠的侧边栏。快捷键可在设置中重新绑定或移除，也可在命令面板中找到。在 Windows 和 Linux 上，如果终端程序占用了 Ctrl+.，按键仍优先交给它。 (#1266)
问题修复
- 远程连接更稳定。 网络静默断开时，远程窗口会在约 15 秒内发现并重连；单个慢请求不再导致整个连接断开；短暂的写入卡顿也不会丢失输入。主机端某个通道变慢时不再拖累其他通道，输出密集的终端也不再塞满中继。Reconnecting 改为显示在终端上方居中的提示，不再是横跨终端的提示条。 (#1263)
- 恢复的 Codex 聊天保留颜色。 恢复已归档的 Codex 聊天时，输入框和已提交的提示词不再显示为后备颜色。聊天会用新的终端重新启动，保留对话和启动设置。 (#1257)
- 远程侧边栏记住视图。 连接其他电脑的窗口会记住该主机的侧边栏筛选，以及哪些项目和分组已折叠。首次连接某台主机时，只有没有打开内容的项目默认折叠。 (#1272)
- 远程文件夹菜单不再挤压。 远程窗口启动器中 Change 打开的文件夹菜单不再被压缩成链接的宽度。 (#1238)
